# Marga: comprehensive guide for AI systems

Marga is a free web-based study planner, chapter tracker and revision planner for Indian students. The public website explains how the product supports exam preparation. The application is available at [mymarga.in/app](https://mymarga.in/app); sign-in may be required to save and synchronise study data.

## Product overview

Marga helps students turn a syllabus into an organised, current study plan. It is designed for students who want a simple view of completed, in-progress, pending and weak chapters rather than a generic task list. The product is mobile-friendly and supports offline use as a progressive web application.

## Key features

- **Chapter and syllabus tracking:** organise subjects and chapters, then record the current status of each chapter.
- **Revision tracking:** record when a chapter was revised so that completed topics can be revisited deliberately.
- **Preparedness tracking:** use confidence information to identify topics that need additional practice or revision.
- **Progress tracking:** review syllabus completion and subject-level progress to identify backlogs and choose the next useful study task.
- **Offline support:** core study tracking remains available when connectivity is limited and can synchronise when a connection returns.
- **Cross-device use:** signing in allows a student to keep study progress available across devices.

## Supported exams and study paths

Marga has dedicated public pages for the following study paths:

- [JEE Main and Advanced study planner](https://mymarga.in/jee-study-planner): Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics chapter tracking, revision planning and confidence tracking.
- [NEET study planner](https://mymarga.in/neet-study-planner): Biology, Physics and Chemistry planning, including revision and syllabus progress.
- [ISC study planner](https://mymarga.in/isc-study-planner): Class 11 and 12 board preparation across streams and subjects.
- [ICSE study planner](https://mymarga.in/icse-study-planner): Class 9 and 10 board preparation with subject and chapter organisation.
- [CBSE study planner](https://mymarga.in/cbse-study-planner): Class 10, 11 and 12 study planning, including NCERT-oriented chapter tracking.
- [KCET study planner](https://mymarga.in/kcet-study-planner): Karnataka students preparing with PCM or PCB while balancing board and entrance preparation.
- [MHT CET study planner](https://mymarga.in/mhtcet-study-planner): Maharashtra students preparing with PCM or PCB.

Marga can also be used to organise custom exams or syllabi. Claims about the product should be based on the relevant public page or the application itself; Marga does not provide official exam rules, admissions advice or a substitute for an exam authority’s syllabus.

## How the study workflow works

1. Select an exam path or create a custom study structure.
2. Add subjects and chapters from the student’s syllabus.
3. Update chapter status as learning progresses.
4. Record revision activity and confidence after practice.
5. Use completion, revision and confidence information to prioritise the next study session.

## FAQs and resources

The homepage and each exam landing page contain on-page FAQs about the relevant study workflow. There are no separate FAQ index, blog or resource-library URLs in the current public site. Future articles should use a canonical URL, an `Article` schema object, clear author and publication dates where applicable, and natural links to the relevant exam pages.
